title: Parts with no category, vendor, or bin assigned are excluded when that filter is active
custom_preconds:
1. You are on the Parts Velocity report with data loaded.
2. A part with in-window activity exists that has NO category assigned; another with NO vendor; an inventory part with NO bin location.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the three parts appear with no filters active.
2. Activate any Category filter and look for the category-less part.
3. Clear it, activate any Vendor filter, and look for the vendor-less part.
4. Clear it, activate any Bin filter, and look for the bin-less inventory part.
custom_expected:
1. The part with no category does not appear when any Category filter is active.
2. The part with no vendor does not appear when any Vendor filter is active.
3. The inventory part with no bin location does not appear when any Bin filter is active.
